card: Fixes a bug where MuSig2 metadata from unrelated descriptors is accidentally populated into PSBT inputs. When descriptorprocesspsbt or utxoupdatepsbt is called with multiple descriptors, aggregate pubkey and participant derivation path data were added to input fields regardless of whether the aggregate was involved in the input script. The signer now checks for aggregate pubkey involvement before attaching MuSig2 data to the PSBT. This resolves issue #36323.
evidence: Fixes linked issue #36323: 'wallet/psbt/musig2: overpopulating participant leaf_hashes in utxoupdatepsbt and descriptorprocesspsbt'.

PR description explains the mechanism: 'if one of the given descriptors involved a MuSig2, the MuSig2 information would be accidentally added to the SignatureData which results in those fields appearing in the resulting PSBT.'
problem: When descriptorprocesspsbt or utxoupdatepsbt runs with multiple descriptors, MuSig2 information across all descriptors is pooled into a single SigningProvider. The signer previously assumed all MuSig2 data in the provider belonged to the input being signed, leaking unrelated aggregate pubkeys and participant derivation paths into the resulting PSBT fields.

risk.why: A flaw in MuSig2 involvement validation could omit necessary signing metadata from PSBTs, breaking MuSig2 multisig coordination or signing flows.

summary: Defers filling MuSig2 aggregate pubkey details and participant BIP 32 derivation paths until after verifying that the aggregate pubkey is actually involved in the script being signed. This prevents extraneous MuSig2 metadata from being injected into PSBT inputs when a SigningProvider holds information for multiple descriptors, such as during descriptorprocesspsbt and utxoupdatepsbt calls. A regression test is added to verify that MuSig2 PSBT fields are omitted for unrelated inputs.
